flags.message: The petition is marked nonempty and untruncated, but its appendix supplies only the beginning of the trial-court order before a notice that additional material is available in the Clerk's Office; the listed federal district-court order is likewise not readable in the supplied text. The appellate writ and review denials are readable. Forecast uses petitioner's account of the missing rulings only as advocacy and treats finality and substantive grounds as uncertain.
